plan.summary: Take older/other-production reviews off current shows (BRO-4432): As You Like It 2026 Globe (Guardian 2022 Sohoplace, Times 2023 Globe), Oliver! (a Stage review of The Other Place), a Rosie O'Donnell news post, and five Broadway entries carrying the Guardian's London review of a different production (found by the new audit class G). Also clears the wrong 1916 cast on As You Like It. Kept on purpose (same production, declared priorRuns): My Son's a Queer, Abigail's Party, The Enormous Crocodile, The Comedy About Spies, Going Bacharach return, and the London-to-Broadway transfers of Enron, Jerusalem, Oslo and Prima Facie. Shows and dates are in bro-4432-b.json.
steps: Set wrongProduction + a manual wrongProductionReason on 8 review files
Reject the Rosie O'Donnell announcement post as not_a_review
